title: Causal held-session next-action inference from human information-sampling state
task_kind: Neural-data/behavior understanding: causal processed-state prediction and reference reconstruction. This is human behavior from a neuroscience study, not neural-signal decoding or published ANN/symbolic/imaging reproduction.

paper.title: Interpretable abstractions of artificial neural networks predict behavior and neural activity during human information gathering

scientific_question: Given only the currently revealed processed state and permitted within-trial history, how well can a method assign probabilities to the next recorded sampling or stopping action in a held session of the same person?
why_substantial: This preserves the complete main behavioral assay, four-action outcome, within-trial causal sequence, initial-information manipulation through the released processed variables, all people and sessions, and genuine out-of-session prediction. It tests both numerically verified prediction and interpretation of dependent uncertainty. Rare stopping actions remain explicit instead of hiding behind accuracy. It does not substitute a tiny subset, simulated observations or an answer lookup for human behavior.

scope_relation.difference: This is a new explicit behavioral-data-understanding assignment in the neural track, which includes the user-selected behavioral tasks. It neither replaces the separate held paper-reproduction project nor asserts completion of its ANN/symbolic/lesion/transfer/neural obligations.
scope_relation.counting: If admitted, one behavioral-data task in this source family; references, folds, modes, trials and replay episodes add no tasks. The separate full-paper proposal remains unregistered. Any later admission must disclose the shared paper/cohort and not claim another independent source family.

cohort.unit: Participant; sessions and trials nested within participant. Decisions are not independent participants.
cohort.eligibility: The entire released eligible two-option processed assay is used under the accepted source exclusions. Original warm-up/three-option/timeout/fewer-than-three-sample filtering and canonical participant mapping remain disclosed; missing raw acquisition logs prevent independent reconstruction of every original exclusion.
cohort.full_population_rule: Every required participant/session/trial/decision must be accounted for. An incomplete or invalid submission fails the complete evaluation; never score only successful trials.

inputs.wire: Opaque HMAC token, first-query marker and one target-free current observation. One valid probability commitment precedes the next observation; an end frame is sent only after the last commitment.
inputs.permitted_history: Previously revealed observations and own previous actions/messages within the same trial, under the existing endpoint; no state survives to another trial in isolated candidate evaluation.
inputs.prohibited: Held labels, source-row/person/session/trial identifiers, future trajectory/length, current unknown target, per-case score feedback, fitted author VoI/checkpoints, reference predictions and target-derived selection traces.
inputs.source_limits: Processed count/cue conventions and within-trial chronology are validated; initial_visit generator/consumer discrepancy, raw JavaScript timing/initial-cue history and source-exclusion provenance remain limitations. No lossless raw sensory-history claim.

split.policy: 80 outer folds: hold each of four sessions of each of 20 people, train on their other three sessions; inner three-session selection fixes model family/penalty without outer outcomes. This is not chronological forecasting.
split.coverage: Exactly 4,884 accepted trials and 163,135 eligible decisions across all 20 people and 80 sessions; 19,536 source-defined excluded rows remain disclosed. Complete no-refit protected replay is implemented but unrun.

conditions.paper_data: Paper/supplement, causal task specification and legally usable training/development data; no author implementation or fitted answer artifacts.
conditions.paper_data_code: Same evidence, splits, budget and evaluator plus the pinned official implementation, excluding fitted outcomes/checkpoints/answer files.
conditions.evaluation_modes: A frozen prediction program and a case-adaptive scientific agent can be compared only with matched causal observations, permitted history, tools and budgets. Each mode must commit before revelation. These are experimental conditions, not extra benchmarks.
conditions.not_executed: No matched LLM, code-access or mode-comparison study has been run. This proposal does not claim a code-assistance effect or post-training result.
conditions.budget_status: Exact agent/model compute and executable training bindings must be fixed for a future study before test access; current accepted construction runtime is evidence for reference feasibility, not a selected agent budget.

outputs.prediction: Exactly one vector in class order[1,2,3,4] for every eligible decision. Each value is an int/float (notbool), finite and strictly between0and1; math.fsum must differ from1 by no more than1e-9, after which the accepted scorer normalizes only this roundoff discrepancy. Classes3and4 are terminal actions; the accepted scorer remains unchanged.
outputs.reference_reconstruction: Complete per-fold/per-session/per-person losses for all four named references; paired participant uncertainty and secondary stopping metrics; provenance and numerical discrepancy report.
outputs.improvement: A frozen new method and complete protected predictions, compared against the prespecified reference set with development-only choices. A null or inconclusive result is valid; no tuning on test outcomes.

scoring.primary: Mean decision negative log probability within held session, equal four sessions within person, equal20persons.
secondary: Four action recalls, explicitly both stopping actions

uncertainty.accepted_method: Paired participant percentile bootstrap,10000 draws, seed20261114; preserve full paired participant summaries.
uncertainty.no_pseudoreplication: Do not use decisions, trials or80sessions as independent biological units.

scoring.failure: Missing/duplicate/out-of-order/malformed commitments, wrong population or incomplete containment are full-evaluation failures; failures remain in reported denominators.
scoring.improvement_standard: The prespecified candidate-minus-family_train_selected primary NLL contrast must be reported over all20 paired participants with dependence-aware uncertainty. No outer-test selection of models, comparator, restarts or reporting subsets. Before a new confirmatory study, fix the meaningful effect threshold and interval/test procedure; a stronger scientific-reasoning/frontier claim additionally requires a history-sensitive competent comparator or explicitly matched-information ablation. Other named-reference contrasts follow the separate descriptive/multiplicity policy.
scoring.contamination: Public data and published results may be in pretraining. Curator-held evaluation labels and network/filesystem isolation do not prove unseen training content; describe this as controlled public-data replay unless genuinely new evaluation data are supplied.
scoring.primary_comparator: For a future candidate improvement study, compare its primary participant/session-balanced NLL with the frozen family_train_selected reference. This comparator is fixed by the task, and its per-fold family/penalty choice uses only inner training sessions. Do not select the comparator from outer held scores.
scoring.secondary_comparison_policy: Uniform, context_counts and ridge_train_selected remain complete required reference reports. Their candidate contrasts are descriptive by default; any confirmatory secondary family requires a prospectively specified multiplicity procedure. Existing historical reference comparisons remain descriptive and are not relabelled confirmatory.

accepted_references.relationship: Four scored reference conditions, not four independent model families; train-selected family reuses the chosen context/ridge model.
accepted_references.interpretation: The difference is inconclusive under the reported interval; low stopping recalls remain material. No SOTA/improvement/LLM effect is established.

primary_outputs: One recorded action in classes 1,2,3,4 per eligible decision; classes 3 and 4 are terminal actions. The target is the action, not reproduction of the historical reference loss table.
biological_unit: 20 participants; four sessions per participant and dependent trials/decisions nested within them.
case_definition: A next-action commitment within one completed two-option trial; fresh participant episode per trial.

inputs: Current nL,nR,nB,rL,rR,muL,muR,gL,gR,first_visit,after_first_visit,t fields, plus opaque token and new-trial marker.

Only previous revealed observations and own messages within that trial. The candidate successor additionally receives the corresponding unchanged TRAIN-selected model artifact; comparisons using that tool must disclose and match this access.
forbidden_inputs: Private source row, person/session/trial identities, action, future trajectory or remaining length, per-case feedback.
Held outcomes, reference predictions and outcome-selected model choice; cross-trial candidate state.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: OnlineSession binds each private source_row to an HMAC-SHA256 token. Candidate receives the current token only; private IDs and complete query list remain evaluator-owned.
allowed_inputs.split: 80 outer folds: hold each of four sessions of each of 20 people, train on their other three sessions; inner three-session selection fixes model family/penalty without outer outcomes. This is not chronological forecasting.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Exactly 4,884 accepted trials and 163,135 eligible decisions across all 20 people and 80 sessions; 19,536 source-defined excluded rows remain disclosed. Complete no-refit protected replay is implemented but unrun.

controls: Report both stopping recalls so prevalent sampling actions cannot hide rare-action failure.
Validate source clock/cursor/first-visit chronology and source evidence-versus-initial-cue disjunction; mu=(r+1)/(n+2) is not universal for initial cues.
Match model-artifact/tool access between an investigator and frozen method; artifact-assisted performance is a separate condition from unassisted numeric inference.
Freeze normalization, model selection and participant state reset before held-session exposure.

direct_observation.representation: Potential no-tools numeric inference from one 12-field current observation and permitted previous observations.
direct_observation.boundary: Commit four probabilities before the next observation; original state history is preserved and later trial length withheld.
missing: No direct-model prompt/response transport or matched complete cohort trial established.

missing: No typed viewer is needed to express the current numeric target; no viewer capability or result is claimed.

tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh trial state; no target feedback; tool calls and artifact access matched to the frozen comparison.
missing: Candidate source is an executable endpoint, not a delivered per-case LLM investigation harness.

frozen_program.boundary: All 4,884 trials/163,135 commitments; no new trusted model fits; candidate-internal computation not certified training-free.
missing: Complete protected execution and candidate runtime/read qualification remain unestablished.

primary.name: Participant/session-balanced four-action negative log likelihood
primary.aggregation: Average decision NLL within each held session; equally average its four sessions within each person; equally average all 20 people.
primary.rationale: Proper probabilistic next-action scoring preserves rare stopping alternatives and prevents long sessions from dominating the scientific unit.

secondary: All four action recalls, macro recall, confusion and accuracy; explicitly report both terminal-action recalls.
Stopping probability Brier score and complete paired person effects.

comparators.procedure: Existing fixed primary comparator; family and ridge penalty selected only by inner training-session NLL. Never choose comparator on held losses.

comparators.inputs: Same state/training folds, with uniform independent of state.
comparators.procedure: Required complete descriptive references; do not count selected-family reuse as an additional independent model family.

comparators.inputs: Identical causal within-trial state history and permitted immutable artifact access.
comparators.procedure: Required prospective comparator or matched-history ablation for attribution to per-case scientific investigation; currently not qualified.

nuisance_controls: Report both stopping recalls so prevalent sampling actions cannot hide rare-action failure.
Validate source clock/cursor/first-visit chronology and source evidence-versus-initial-cue disjunction; mu=(r+1)/(n+2) is not universal for initial cues.
Match model-artifact/tool access between an investigator and frozen method; artifact-assisted performance is a separate condition from unassisted numeric inference.
Freeze normalization, model selection and participant state reset before held-session exposure.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired participant percentile bootstrap over all 20 persons, with accepted 10,000 draws and seed 20261114; keep sessions and decisions nested. The existing reference interval is inconclusive and remains historical.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete 20x4 population and every eligible trial/decision. Reject duplicate/unknown/missing or out-of-order commitments and nonfinite or nonpositive four-class probabilities; sum tolerance is 1e-9, normalized only for roundoff. No successful-only scoring.
